blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Board of Investments (BOI) found no irregularities in Cale88 Foods Corp.’s export transactions involving Chinese companies, a defense witness testified at Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial on Friday. Cale88, a banana chips manufacturing company linked to Duterte’s husband, lawyer Manases Carpio, came under scrutiny during the prosecution’s presentation of evidence
